grading_criteria.value_normalization: Decimal→float, date→ISO 날짜, 자정 datetime은 해당 timezone의 ISO 날짜로 접기(그 외 datetime은 UTC ISO). date_trunc 답과 CAST(.. AS DATE) 답은 같은 값으로 비교된다.
grading_criteria.row_comparison: 행 다중집합 비교. 컬럼 이름·순서는 채점하지 않되, 하나의 컬럼 순열을 전 행에 일관 적용해야 한다(행마다 다른 뒤섞임은 오답). mode=ordered는 추가로 sort_check 정렬축 단조성을 채점한다(동률 내 순서 미채점).
grading_criteria.numeric_tolerance: 실수는 rel/abs 1e-6 (math.isclose) 이내면 정답. 정수·문자열은 완전 일치.
grading_criteria.chart: expected_chart가 명시된 질문만 visualization.chart_type 일치를 채점한다. 나머지는 차트 미채점.
grading_criteria.chart_mode: mode=chart: 결과 셰이프가 다중 정답인 질문(히스토그램 등 — raw 값 반환과 SQL 비닝이 모두 정답)은 미거부·실행 성공·행 존재·expected_chart 일치만 채점한다. 행 셰이프는 채점하지 않는다.
grading_criteria.failure_detail: 실패 시 컬럼 구성 차이 → 처음 어긋난 행 쌍(정규화 값) 순으로 원인을 기록한다.

results.question: TRACE 알람은 전부 몇 건이야?
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trace_alarm_history LIMIT 500

results.question: SUMMARY 알람 총 건수를 알려줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM summary_alarm_history LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_summary_alarms FROM summary_alarm_history LIMIT 500

results.question: 챔버별 TRACE 알람 건수를 많은 순서대로 보여줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT chamber, count(*) AS cnt FROM trace_alarm_history GROUP BY chamber ORDER BY cnt DESC, chamber ASC LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT chamber, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM trace_alarm_history GROUP BY chamber ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: 설비별 SUMMARY 알람 건수를 집계해줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT equipment, count(*) AS cnt FROM summary_alarm_history GROUP BY equipment LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT equipment, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM summary_alarm_history GROUP BY equipment LIMIT 500

results.question: PH_FOCUS 파라미터에서 발생한 TRACE 알람은 몇 건이야?
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trace_alarm_history WHERE parameter = 'PH_FOCUS' LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trace_alarm_history WHERE parameter = 'PH_FOCUS' LIMIT 500

results.question: 2026년 6월 3일 하루 동안 발생한 TRACE 알람 건수는?
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trace_alarm_history WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-06-03 00:00:00+09' AND occurred_at < '2026-06-04 00:00:00+09' LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trace_alarm_count FROM trace_alarm_history WHERE CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) = '2026-06-03' LIMIT 500

results.question: 챔버별로 처리한 wafer 수를 알려줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT chamber_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM lot_history GROUP BY chamber_id LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT chamber_id, COUNT(wafer_id) AS wafer_count FROM lot_history GROUP BY chamber_id LIMIT 500

results.question: 파라미터별 summary 평균값(value_mean)의 평균을 구해줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT parameter, avg(value_mean) AS avg_mean FROM summary_data GROUP BY parameter LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(value_mean) AS average_value_mean FROM summary_data GROUP BY parameter LIMIT 500
detail: set 불일치 — 컬럼 수 불일치: gold 2열['parameter', 'avg_mean'] vs generated 1열['average_value_mean']

results.question: evaluation 테이블에서 alarm_type별 행 수 분포를 보여줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT alarm_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM evaluation GROUP BY alarm_type LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT alarm_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM evaluation GROUP BY alarm_type LIMIT 500

results.question: fdc_trace에 저장된 측정 포인트는 총 몇 개야?
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM fdc_trace LIMIT 500

results.question: 계측(metrology)에서 measure_type별 평균 측정값을 알려줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT measure_type, avg(measured_value) AS avg_value FROM metrology GROUP BY measure_type LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT measure_type, AVG(measured_value) AS average_measured_value FROM metrology GROUP BY measure_type LIMIT 500

results.question: 가장 최근에 발생한 TRACE 알람 5건의 alarm_id를 보여줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT alarm_id FROM trace_alarm_history ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, alarm_id DESC LIMIT 5
results.generated_sql: SELECT alarm_id FROM trace_alarm_history ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 일자별 TRACE 알람 발생 추이를 보여줘
results.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS day, count(*) AS cnt FROM trace_alarm_history GROUP BY date_trunc('day', occurred_at) ORDER BY day ASC LIMIT 500
results.generated_sql: SELECT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM trace_alarm_history GROUP BY alarm_date ORDER BY alarm_date LIMIT 500

results.question: TRACE 알람 측정값(value)의 분포를 히스토그램으로 보여줘
results.generated_sql: SELECT value, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM trace_alarm_history GROUP BY value ORDER BY value LIMIT 500
